AI Notes.value: [Scout research, unverified] Independent designer in Zurich, works from a 26-person shared studio; visual identity, branding, signage. Cafes, hotels, jewellery and drinks brands; co-founder of the Urban Lemonade identity. Setup deliberately flexible. Caveat: says he now takes 'just a few projects a year', so capacity may be limited; worth an early conversation. Primary public presence is Instagram; no portfolio site located yet. (Name shown ASCII; native spelling Kevin Hoegger / Hogger.)
